- Bulk density for chopped fruit: 0.6 g/ml, so 94 x 0.6 = about 56 g.
- Count check: roughly 20 visible cubes at about 5-6 g each gives about 100 g. The two estimates disagree, so I take a middle value of about 75 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: no base layer visible. The fruit sits on the plate surface only.

Estimated energy: 75 g x 0.34 = about 26 kcal.
